name: Command
description: A command palette dialog with grouped, filterable actions and keyboard navigation.
usage:
<Command
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  groups={[
    { label: 'Projects', items: [{ id: 'orion', label: 'Open Orion', onSelect: () => undefined }] },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The modal surface that owns focus, dismissal, and scroll locking while the palette is open.
The filter field, focused on open, with a caller-set placeholder.
A labelled cluster of related commands, like "Project" or "Danger zone".
One command with a label, optional icon, and a keyboard hint such as ⌘N.

dos: Group commands under short labels so filtering reads as structured sections.
Write verb-led item labels and show shortcut hints where they exist.
Set placeholder and emptyMessage to match the palette's scope.
donts: Don't use the palette as site search over content; use SearchOverlay.
Don't run destructive commands without a follow-up AlertDialog confirmation.
Don't overload it with every possible action; keep it to high-frequency commands.

examples.title: Palette
examples.description: Arrows cycle filtered items, Enter runs the action, state resets on open.

examples.title: Scoped palette
examples.description: A palette scoped to admin commands with its own placeholder and empty message.

examples.title: Keyboard first
examples.description: Bind a global shortcut to open the palette; keep item hints scannable.

guidance.useWhen: Power users need fast keyboard access to many actions.
guidance.avoidWhen: There are few actions; use visible buttons or a Menu.
guidance.behavior: Filtering, highlight, and selection reset on every open.
guidance.responsive: The panel caps at viewport width with its own internal scroll.

keyboard.action: Moves the highlight through the filtered commands.
Runs the highlighted command and closes the palette.
Closes the palette without running a command.
Filters the command list; query and highlight reset on every open.

notes: The input renders role="combobox" with aria-activedescendant pointing at the highlighted option in the listbox.
Each command renders role="option" with aria-selected reflecting the highlight.
Focus is trapped in the dialog shell while the palette is open.

apiEntries.description:
